Long, flowing platinum white hair with straight bangs and a silky texture. Cold, narrow pale blue eyes with a piercing expression. Apparent age of early twenties with a mature, regal countenance. Slender, graceful build. A high-collared, sleeveless white and gold royal gown with a long sweeping cape and a gold crown atop the head. Signature gold ornaments adorn the ears and wrists.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain skin
